items.decision_note: Member listing, access revocation, and member removal are independently testable operations, but the available evidence does not define their semantics well enough for a safe split.

unresolved_candidate.description: Client answers were supplied through Slack but are absent from the observable history, so the Release 3 versus Phase 5 scope of multi-user and owner-facing metering capabilities cannot be reconstructed safely.

The available evidence does not establish whether member listing, access revocation, and member removal should remain one administration mechanism or be split into independently evolving Requirements.
Wallet is named as confirmed scope, but no observable message defines the intended Wallet behavior well enough to create an atomic Requirement.
